t: The area bounded by the curve y=f(x),y=x and the lines x=1,x=t is (t+√(1+t²))−√2−1 squnit, for all t>1. If f(x) satisfying f(x)>x for all x>1, then f(x) is equal to
s:
It is given that, f(x)>x, for all x>1. So, area bounded by y=f(x),y=x and the lines x=1,x=t
is given by ∫_1^t {f(x)−x}dx
But this area is given equal to (t+√(1+t²)−√2−1) sq unit. Therefore, ∫_1^t {f(x)−x}dx=t+√(1+t²)−√2−1, for all t>1
On differentiating both sides w.r.t. t, we get
f(t)−t=1+t/(√(1+t²)) for all t>1
⇒f(t)=t+1+t/(√(1+t²)) for all t>1
Hence, f(x)=x+1+x/(√(1+x²)) for all x>1
